description: Synthetic: a finished Claude Code turn in auto mode with a long multi-section status report, whose last paragraph hands the user a `! command` inline because the agent's own attempt was denied, followed by a link; background agents still run below the input box. The hand-over is the agent waiting on the user, so it is an offer (Send it) and the pane needs them, even though it ends a report rather than asking a question.
